velocity trend (m/s)","hideWhenNoData":true},"glossary_md":{"type":"splunk.markdown","options":{"backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)","markdown":"### About these metrics
- **Weight** — total body weight from the scale. **Neutral** — goal-dependent; the *trend* matters more than any single reading.
- **Body fat %** — proportion of your weight that is fat, via bioimpedance. **↓ lower is generally better** within a healthy range (too low is also unhealthy).
- **Fat mass** — body fat by mass (weight × fat %). **↓ lower is generally better** in a healthy range.
- **Lean mass** (fat-free mass) — everything that isn't fat: muscle, bone, water, organs. **↑ higher is generally better** — preserving lean mass is a good sign, especially while losing weight.
- **BMI** — weight ÷ height² (computed from your registry height). **Context** — a rough screen; ~18.5–24.9 is the typical 'normal' band, but it ignores muscle vs fat.
- **Pulse at weigh-in** — heart rate the scale measured while you stood on it (bpm). **↓ lower is generally better** as a loose fitness proxy — but it's a standing spot reading, not true resting HR.
- **Muscle mass** — body mass that is muscle. **↑ higher is generally better** — preserving/building muscle supports metabolism and strength.
- **Bone mass** — estimated bone mineral mass. **Context** — fairly stable; watch for a downward drift over long periods.
- **Body water** — total body water. **Context** — hydration + body-composition indicator; swings can reflect hydration, not fat change.
- **Visceral fat** — an index (not kg) of fat around your organs. **↓ lower is better** — Withings flags ~13+ as elevated; it's a stronger health risk marker than total fat.
- **Pulse-wave velocity (PWV)** — arterial stiffness (m/s), the same cardiovascular signal Oura estimates. **↓ lower is better** — stiffer arteries push it up.

_Muscle / bone / water / visceral / PWV need a capable Withings scale (Body Cardio, Body Scan, Body+); a weight-only scale leaves those panels hidden._

_Weight/mass follow the **Units** toggle (kg or lb); the number is unit-free and the unit is shown in each panel title. Bioimpedance body-fat is an estimate — consistency (same scale, same time of day) makes the trend more reliable than absolutes. Muscle/bone/water breakdown isn't ingested yet._

**Learn more:** [Withings — Body composition](https://www.withings.com/us/en/body-composition)
- **Blood Oxygen (SpO2)** — blood-oxygen saturation from a ScanWatch (95–100% typical); also feeds the cross-vendor **Wellness → Vitals** tab.
- **VO₂max** — estimated cardiorespiratory fitness (ml/kg/min), from a Withings watch.
- **Blood Pressure** — systolic/diastolic (mmHg) from a Withings BPM."}},"spo2_sv":{"type":"splunk.singlevalue","title":"Blood Oxygen
